about: SP9: statements run by mysql2 3.24 (typeCast off, through the 1.1.4 DB host) and by the Rust spike client against MySQL 8.4 and MariaDB 11; test/db-wire-sp9.int.test.ts writes the goldens, src-tauri/crates/unimux-db/tests/wire_servers.rs compares. `only` limits an entry to one flavour. DML only into sp9_sink.
setup: CREATE DATABASE sp9 CHARACTER SET utf8mb4

CREATE TABLE sp9.t (id INT PRIMARY KEY, d DECIMAL(12,3), f FLOAT, g DOUBLE, dt DATETIME(6), ts TIMESTAMP(3) NULL, tm TIME(2), y YEAR, b BIT(10), vb VARBINARY(8), bl BLOB, c CHAR(4), l1 VARCHAR(10) CHARACTER SET latin1, j JSON, e ENUM('a','b'), s SET('x','y'), u BIGINT UNSIGNED, p POINT)
CREATE TABLE sp9.sink (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, v VARCHAR(10))
CREATE PROCEDURE sp9.two() BEGIN SELECT 1 AS a; SELECT 'x' AS b, NULL AS c; END
mariadbSetup: CREATE TABLE sp9.m (id INT PRIMARY KEY, u UUID, i4 INET4, i6 INET6, js JSON)

queries.sql: SELECT 'a', 'ąę😀', '', 'tab\there\nnl', CONCAT('x', NULL), CHAR(65, 66), _latin1 0xe9, CONVERT('ż' USING latin1), 'it''s'
SELECT 0x00ff, X'', _binary 'abc', CAST('x' AS BINARY), UNHEX('deadbeef'), b'101', BINARY 'q', CAST(0xff AS CHAR CHARACTER SET utf8mb4)
SELECT JSON_OBJECT('b', 1, 'a', JSON_ARRAY(1, 2.50, 'x')), CAST('{"k": 1.0}' AS JSON), JSON_EXTRACT('{"a": "\u00e9"}', '$.a')
SELECT id, d, f, g, dt, ts, tm, y, b, vb, bl, c, l1, j, e, s, u, p FROM sp9.t ORDER BY id
WITH RECURSIVE g(n) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT n + 1 FROM g WHERE n < 2500) SELECT n, n * 1.5 FROM g
UPDATE sp9.t SET c = c WHERE id <= 3
SELECT id, u, i4, i6, js FROM sp9.m
